name: Bottleneck
description: A narrow neck travels down the frame, pinching the first clip into an hourglass and squeezing it through, the second swelling back above it. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: depth
params.description: How narrow the neck gets, as a part of the frame width

params.name: neck
params.description: Height of the pinched region, in frame heights
